scenes.text: How Ship lands a pull request.
It reads the issue, writes a failing test, then makes it pass.
Every gate goes green before the pull request opens.
And every frame can flip right to left, in Egyptian Arabic.

arabic.title: إزاي الـ Ship بيوصل لـ pull request
arabic.caption: وكل frame ممكن يتقلب من اليمين للشمال، بالمصري.
